messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — I pushed a follow-up that changes the /v1/embed API contract to return `model_meta` in the top-level response instead of nested under `meta`. Addressed the review comments from yesterday and added unit tests. Can someone do a quick smoke and sanity-check before I merge? I'm planning to land to canary tonight so would love a quick :eyes:

Jordan: Linking the PR? I can run a local smoke.

Sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3129 — branch is `embed-meta-flat`. The linux-x86 CI job is flaking on one test locally for me: `TestEmbedResponseStructure`. Log below: 

```
--- FAIL: TestEmbedResponseStructure (0.02s)
    embed_test.go:84: expected top-level key "model_meta", got nested "meta"
--- FAIL
```

Lina: I can take the CI job. If it's just an assertion mismatch maybe tests are out-of-sync with the new fixture. Did you update the golden files?

Sam: Yes updated goldens under `testdata/goldens/embed/*` — I ran `go test ./...` on mac and it passed. The CI x86 image might have an older cached fixture.

ci-bot: @Sam — triggered rebuild on linux-x86 matrix job (job id: 8672). Will report back here.

Priya: Quick question about rollout — changing response shape is backward-incompatible for some internal consumers. Is it behind a feature flag or will we maintain both shapes for one deploy cycle?

Sam: Good catch. I've kept the server producing both shapes when `X-Compat-Mode: true` header is set. Default is the new flat `model_meta`. I added an integration test to assert legacy header presence.

Jordan: Running the branch locally now, tests passing on my linux VM. I'll try the smoke against staging canary after the CI rebuild.

ci-bot: linux-x86 job 8672: ✅ passed in 7m32s. All matrix jobs green.

Lina: Ran a quick curl against canary branch image (deployed to staging) — response body includes `model_meta` top-level and legacy when header present. 👍

Sam: Awesome, thanks all. If nobody objects I'll merge around 18:30 PT to hit tonight's canary window. Anyone need more time?

Priya: No objections from infra side. Go ahead.

Jordan: LGTM, minor nit inline but not blocking.

Sam: Noted, will follow up with a tiny cleanup PR tomorrow. Merging after the 18:30 window. :shipit:
